name: A Large Southeastern Hospital Could Improve Certain Security Controls to Enhance Its Ability to Prevent and Detect Cyberattacks
known_limitations: The audited hospital is anonymous, the technical testing occurred in August-September 2022, and only four internet-facing applications were selected. Results cannot be generalized to HHS, CMS, other hospitals, or current operation. Phase 56M preserves audit identity, tested period, finding, recommendation state, and reopening rule.
source_owner: Department of Health and Human Services Office of Inspector General
